Can't reproduce on Windows 10

> Godot v4.7.2.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Intel(R) Arc(TM) B580 Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.8993) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 31.91 GiB memory - WASAPI (192000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

This could be due to third-party software installed on the system. Do you have any third-party programs installed that could intercept keyboard input, or try to do anything that affects all running programs on the system? I would check in the Add/Remove Programs dialog.

I was wondering if it was something to do with the specific keyboard I use; a GMMK 3, from Glorious.

That said, I do not have any third-party programs installed or running that could intercept keyboard input or anything like that. Furthermore, the problem really does only occur when Godot is open and the keyboard gets disconnected.
